summary: Remake of Der Riese with a simple classic layout focused on power, teleporters, Pack-a-Punch, the Fly Trap / Paradoxical Prologue easter egg, the Annihilator reward, a music easter egg, an extra perk side easter egg, and a few small visual side easter eggs.

files.summary: Overall map overview, classic layout, power, teleporters, Pack-a-Punch, the Wonderwaffe DG-2 from the Mystery Box, and the main systems of The Giant.
How to turn on the power, locate the 3 teleporters, link each teleporter to the mainframe, and unlock Pack-a-Punch.
Fly Trap / Paradoxical Prologue easter egg, how to shoot the hidden panel, find the teddy bears, and unlock the Annihilator.
How to activate the Beauty of Annihilation music easter egg by interacting with the 3 hidden music objects.
How to use Monkey Bombs and the teleporter system to activate the giant robot laser and reveal the extra perk hidden under the snow pile.
Visual side easter eggs including the Icarus plane, giant robot head, Maxis office, and teddy bear shadow.
